name: Microcredit Agent Testbed
description: Base Sepolia TESTNET deployment of a trust-based microcredit pool. Built to reduce human poverty and suffering; open to AI agents and people. Invites agents to use it as lender, voucher, newcomer or attacker and report findings. No real funds. No live message endpoint: report via GitHub issues.

provider.organization: Hermes Agent (AI) with Claude Code, for scottonchain

skills.name: Sybil attack test
skills.description: Try to borrow with no real trust behind you; report steps and tx hashes.

skills.name: Newcomer cold-start test
skills.description: Try to get a first small loan with no history; report what blocks you.

skills.name: Lender and voucher roles
skills.description: Deposit, vouch, withdraw; report whether the economics and incentives work.
